# Append all --> export to OpenRefine to fix misspellings in names

```{r load data 1}

setwd("G:/Shared drives/MSP LTER - Public/Q2 - Lakes and Watersheds/Q2.2 - Lakes & Surface Waters/TCMA Lake Research/Research initiatives/Beaches/Received data/Hennepin County/")

# 2007-2012
hc2007 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2007 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "")  %>% # remove empty cells (relic from excel)
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments) 

hc2008 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2008 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "") %>%
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments)

hc2009 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2009 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "") %>%
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments)

hc2010 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2010 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "") %>%
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments)

hc2011 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2011 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "") %>%
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments)

hc2012 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2012 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(date != "") %>%
  rename(beach = beach_park) %>%
  select(date, beach, lake, e_coli_100ml, comments)

# JOIN THEM
hc_2007_2012 <- rbind(hc2007, hc2008, hc2009, hc2010, hc2011, hc2012)


```

```{r}

hc2023 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2023 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename(date = collection_date) %>%
  rename(beach = sample_description) %>%
  select(date, beach,  result, units)


hc2024 <- read.csv("./bf_annotated/2024 hennepin ecoli.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename(date = date_sampled) %>%
  rename(beach = sample_description) %>%
  select(date, beach,  result, units)


hc_2023_2024 <- rbind(hc2023, hc2024)

```


```{r bulk edit and combine all}

# bulk edit
hc_2007_2012 <- hc_2007_2012 %>%
  rename(ecoli = e_coli_100ml) %>%
  mutate(units = "cfu/100mL")

hc_2013_2022 <- hc_2013_2022 %>%
  rename(ecoli = cfu) %>%
  mutate(units = "cfu/100mL")

hc_2023_2024 <- hc_2023_2024 %>%
  rename(ecoli = result) %>%
  mutate(units = "mpn/100mL")


# combine all
hc_all <- full_join(hc_2007_2012, hc_2013_2022)

hc_all <- full_join(hc_all, hc_2023_2024)



# export combined data
write.csv(hc_all, file = "Hennepin_combined_raw.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
